summary: GET /api/orders/express-1002 returns 500 (ValueError: day is out of range for month). order_detail() computes the express delivery estimate with placed_at.replace(day=placed_at.day + 2), which fails when the order date is within 2 days of month end. The seeded order express-1002 is dated the last day of the previous month (Aug 31 here, so day 33).
user_impact: Every detail lookup of an express order created on the 30th or 31st, or on Feb 27-28 and so on, returns HTTP 500. In the evidence that is express-1002, with about 12 500s in 15 minutes. Standard orders and the 200 responses are unaffected.
root_cause: app/main.py:81 uses date.replace(day=day+2) for the delivery estimate instead of date arithmetic. It raises ValueError for any express order whose created_at day is greater than (days in month - 2). The seed data (init_db) deliberately creates express-1002 at the previous month end, which triggers it.

evidence.observation: 19 ERROR lines on the route, all ValueError: day is out of range for month; stack ends at main.py:81 in order_detail.
The span orders.build_detail errors with order.priority=express; order.id=express-1002 on the root span; the db select succeeded.
All 5xx are error_type=ValueError on version 3982ab3; 12.6 500s vs 1.0 200s over 15m.
placed_at.replace(day=placed_at.day + 2); the seed sets express-1002 created_at to the previous month end.
New regression test with a fixed date (2026-08-31) expects 2026-09-02; full suite passes, 6 passed.

changes.description: order_detail: estimated_at = placed_at + timedelta(days=2) instead of replace(day=day+2); timedelta was already imported.
Added test_express_estimate_crosses_month_end, which uses a fixed 2026-08-31 date so it does not depend on today's date. It calls order_detail directly.

tests.summary: 6 passed with the fix. I did not run the new test against the unfixed code: the sandbox blocked the revert command. By inspection it fails, because day 31 + 2 = 33 raises ValueError.

final_message:
INC-20260930-130646-e094: GET /api/orders/express-1002 returns 500 (ValueError: day is out of range for month).
Cause: app/main.py:81 computes the delivery estimate with replace(day=day+2), which breaks near month end. The seeded express-1002 is dated Aug 31.
Fix: use placed_at + timedelta(days=2), plus a regression test with a fixed date. Full suite passes (6 tests).
Verdict: real incident, one-line patch proposed, please deploy and replay /api/orders/express-1002.
